name: Valentin Borisovich Aleskovskii
summary: Soviet chemist and professor who proposed the 'framework' hypothesis and co-founded the molecular layering method.

name: Stanislav Ivanovich Kol'tsov
summary: Soviet chemist and graduate student of Aleskovskii who experimentally substantiated the molecular layering method.

name: Leningrad Technological Institute by Lensovet
summary: Russian educational chemical engineering institute where Aleskovskii studied and worked for decades.

name: Leningrad State University
summary: Major Russian university where Aleskovskii served as rector and founded a department.

name: Naval Research Institute
summary: Research institute in Leningrad where Aleskovskii worked as a research fellow after graduation.

name: Academy of Sciences of the USSR
summary: Soviet scientific academy of which Aleskovskii became a corresponding member.

name: Mary
summary: City in Turkmenistan where Aleskovskii was born.

name: Leningrad
summary: City in Russia where Aleskovskii studied, worked, and lived.

name: Proletarskaya
summary: Station in the Rostov region where Kol'tsov was born.

name: Molecular Layering
summary: Gas-phase layer by layer deposition technology co-founded by Aleskovskii and Kol'tsov.

name: Framework Hypothesis
summary: Theoretical concept proposed by Aleskovskii regarding the chemical structure of solids.

name: T. Suntola
summary: Finnish physicist who independently developed atomic layer epitaxy (ALE).

name: N. A. Kosygin
summary: Prime Minister of the USSR who became interested in ML after a Pravda article.

name: E. K. Kalinin
summary: Deputy Minister of Education who proposed the inter-university program for ML.
